parameters.query:
SELECT n.url, n.title, n.summary, n.source, n.category
FROM news_items n
LEFT JOIN category_prefs p ON p.category = n.category AND p.muted = true
WHERE n.status = 'new' AND p.category IS NULL
ORDER BY n.published_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;
